subject: Request: Merit policy waiver for new hire in review window
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>; Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Merit policy waiver for new hire in review window

Stephanie / Laura —

Quick one: I’m requesting a merit exception for Rohit Alvarez (Eng, IC4) who joined 10 weeks ago and just completed his first-cycle review. People Ops flagged that company policy normally excludes hires within the first 90 days from merit increases; manager submitted a strong appeal citing:

- Exceptional early impact on Infra v2 rollout (led bugfix that reduced latency by 14%)
- Clear comp mismatch vs market for similar contributors we recruited last quarter
I attached the manager appeal and a quick merit-calculation sheet. We’re requesting a 7% merit effective July 1 to bring base closer to target band.

Can you advise approval path? If we need exec sign-off I can pull a short packet. Goal is to avoid losing him during onboarding.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Core Infra
Redwood Inference

Attachment: manager_appeal_rohit.pdf (pdf, 210KB)
Attachment: merit_calculation_ROHIT_ALVAREZ.xlsx (xlsx, 34KB)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Merit policy waiver for new hire in review window

Thanks Marcus —

I read the packet. High-level thoughts before we escalate:

- Evidence is solid (impact + hiring comps).
- Policy exists because payroll cycles and calibration windows make off-cycle changes messy for tax/bonus prorates; that said, exceptions are allowed with leadership sign-off.

Can you confirm: is the manager proposing change to base only (7%) or base + discretionary sign-on rebalancing? Also need a note from the manager on retention risk (one-paragraph).
If it’s base-only, I’ll draft a recommendation memo to the Exec Comp Committee and loop Finance for run-rate impact. We’ll need to route to Payroll vendor (ADP) by 6/25 to make a 7/1 effective date.

If you’d like, I can take this to the committee on Monday morning if you get me the missing bits by end of day tomorrow.

-Stephanie
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Merit policy waiver for new hire in review window

Stephanie —

Confirmed: base only (7%). No sign-on rebalancing. I asked manager for the one-line retention risk and pasted it below from his note: 

"Rohit has received two inbound offers since joining; one is for ~15% above his current base and is recruiting aggressively. If we don’t adjust base, he’s likely to engage and could exit within Q3. He’s been central to the infra stability fixes and is on the critical path for our next release"

I also updated the merit_calculation sheet to show budget impact for FY26 (annualized run-rate + payroll timing).

Let me know if that’s enough for a Monday committee review. Apologies for the tight cadence — manager escalated after last week’s interview outreach.

-Marcus

Attachment: merit_calculation_ROHIT_ALVAREZ.xlsx (xlsx, 2 versions; updated)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Merit policy waiver for new hire in review window

Appreciate the packet and the manager note. A few operational items to call out before we route to Exec Comp: 

- Payroll timing: to make a 7/1 effective date we need final approval and signed memo to Payroll vendor by close of business on 6/25.
- Bonus/proration: because Rohit joined mid-cycle he will have a prorated bonus; a base increase does not change the prorated amount for the period already completed. Finance will confirm whether we should recompute target bonus in the same run.
- Calibration: recommend we include two peer comparables from last quarter’s hires and a short manager calibration note (how Rohit will be measured over next 90 days).
If you can provide the peer comps and the 90-day measurement bullets, I’ll assemble the memo and label it "Exec Comp packet — merit exception" and route to Vivek for approval.

-Laur a
Head of Total Rewards (interim)
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Merit policy waiver for new hire in review window

Thanks team — I reviewed the materials and the manager note. Given risk and clear impact, I approve moving forward with an exception to policy for base-only at 7% effective 7/1, subject to the following checklist being satisfied before routing to Payroll:

- Final manager calibration bullets (3) on next 90-day milestones.
- Two peer comparables attached (salary bands + join dates).
- Finalized memo with requested sign-off block for Exec Comp Committee (my signature + CFO).

Stephanie/Laura: please confirm once the packet is assembled and I will sign. Marcus: please ask manager to prioritize the 90-day bullets — we need these within 24 hours.

I am ok expediting the Exec Comp Committee review for Monday morning. If anything changes, inform me immediately.

-Vivek
SVP, Operations
Redwood Inference

--- Forwarded message ---
From: Ana Soto <ana.soto@talentops.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2026 16:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Merit policy waiver for new hire in review window
To: Payroll Vendor <payroll@adp-example.com>

FYI: once Redwood confirms final approval we’ll accept the update for a 7/1 effective date. Please hold until we get the signed memo.

Ana Soto
Senior Client Lead — TalentOps (vendor)
